title: Changhong Jiahua Privatisation Collapses After PRC Approvals Fall Through
Changhong Jiahua Shares Rise After Hongtu's Takeover Bid Fails
Sichuan Changhong Electronic Holding Group Co., Ltd. cancelled the acquisition of 22.56% stake in Changhong Jiahua Holdings Limited from Zhu, Zhao, Su and other shareholders.
